exercises.question: Modify the example to keep three decimal places instead of two.

tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes dotnet CLI behave that way? (C# ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, World!". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes int behave that way? (C# ch.2)
The worked sample prints "Immutable with value equality". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes class behave that way? (C# ch.3)
The worked sample prints "Implementers must supply Total()". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes property behave that way? (C# ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Deferred, lazy sequence". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes async behave that way? (C# ch.5)
The worked sample prints "Suspends without blocking a thread". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes List<T> behave that way? (C# ch.6)
The worked sample prints "Switch expression applies 10% off". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)
Which concept makes Minimal APIs behave that way? (C# ch.7)
The worked sample prints "HTTP GET returns the book list". Which statement caused it? (ch.7)

assessment.q: Write C# code that reads a value, transforms it and prints the result. (final)
What does the score of 14.3 marks per chapter tell you about this exam's structure? (final)
